item.description:
Snapping

  • Windows that slide into place, as some apps do while an accessibility tool like VoiceOver or Grammarly is running, now snap in one click. Before, a layout could take several clicks to arrive, a step at a time.
  • Every snap now checks that the window got where it was sent, and tries again if it didn't.

Updates

  • Updates now install as soon as they've downloaded, while you're not using WindowSmith, instead of waiting for you to quit it. Before, a copy left running could keep offering an older update after a newer one was out.

Restore

  • Restore now puts a window back where it was before you first dragged it to snap. Snapping it again by dragging no longer changes where Restore takes it.
